lessons.correction: Continue developing your ground army and economy. Maintain current production and technology levels while keeping an eye on potential threats.
lessons.mistake: Launching an unnecessary attack that sacrifices drones or disrupts your economy, or neglecting scouting for tech switches or all-ins.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if enemy pressure becomes apparent, or if you scout a tech switch or expansion timing.
lessons.title: Avoid premature aggression in a macro mirror
lessons.when: Early-midgame, both players ground-oriented with light tech and moderate production, strong economy and expansion.
lessons.why: Both players are in a similar macro state; continuing to develop economy and ground forces keeps you competitive and ready to respond.

lessons.correction: Strengthen your ground army by adding more Roaches and possibly tech upgrades. Continue to expand your economy and production.
lessons.mistake: Over-investing in Roaches if the opponent is teching to air, or neglecting expansion and economy.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the enemy shows signs of an air transition or a timing attack.
lessons.title: Match heavy production with robust ground forces
lessons.when: Midgame, enemy ground posture with heavy production and moderate tech, your army includes Roaches.
lessons.why: Enemy's heavy production suggests a large army; matching production and strengthening ground forces helps defend or counter-attack.

lessons.correction: Focus on expanding your economy and establishing a solid foundation. Continue producing Zerglings and Queens for defense.
lessons.mistake: Falling behind in economy by making unnecessary units that could be drones.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the enemy shows signs of an early attack or a fast expansion.
lessons.title: Prioritize economy over unnecessary units in early game
lessons.when: Early game, both ground-oriented with moderate production and light tech, your economy moderate and expansion developing.
lessons.why: A strong economy is crucial for long-term success; building a solid foundation allows you to outproduce the enemy in the midgame.
